attr.title: Ghostship
attr.desc: Ghostship is the HarbourMasters PC port of Super Mario 64, built from the decompilation, with enhancements such as higher frame rates, widescreen support and mod support.
attr.inst: Copy your Super Mario 64 US or JP .z64 rom to ports/ghostship/baseroms. On first launch answer Yes to the prompts to convert it to sm64.o2r, which can take a few minutes.
